The packet writes 'Li Jian-yu' with a hyphen; that rendering is kept.
The packet Chinese is 陛贄 and the packet English is Lu Zhi. The pair is kept as written and not corrected from outside the packet.
The emperor who valued Can (上) before Dezong is named in s0047 is treated as Dezong, strongly inferred from the same narrative, not from an explicit identification in the early units.
Unnamed Fen brothers were beaten to death with Cao Fen; they are not given a separate person because 芬兄弟 overlaps the name Fen.
This chunk writes 陸贄 for Lu Zhi. Chunk 001 writes 陛贄. Each unit is kept as the packet writes it.
嗣虢王則之 is rendered 'Heir of the Prince of Guo Ze Zhi'; s0085 writes 李則之 'Li Ze Zhi'. One person, packet renderings kept.
父圮 is rendered 'Qi', the same English as the surname in 齊映. The characters differ; the father is a separate person.
The Chinese is 泚; the packet English is Zhu Ci. That rendering is kept.
李楚琳 is rendered 'Li Chu Lin' with a space. That rendering is kept.
帝 and 上 in this stretch, after Dezong is named, are treated as Dezong. Strongly inferred, not a separate unnamed emperor.
The emperor in the Qi Ying narrative is not named in this chunk. He is not identified with Dezong from outside the packet.
三年正月 and the later bare year-counts are kept as written. They are not converted, and the era is not filled in from nearby Zhenyuan units.
Zixuan is Liu Zi's grandfather and Kuang is Liu Zi's father, so Zixuan is treated as Kuang's father. Strongly inferred.
曹參 is inside 功曹參軍 and is not a person.
李兼 is rendered Li Jian. That is kept, and he is not identified with Li Jian-yu or with Jian son of Linghu Zhang in earlier chunks.
Lu Mai's courtesy name 子玄 is the same characters as Zan's grandfather Zixuan in s0174. They are different people.
The packet's Chinese writes the letters MH for Lu Mai's cousin, and the English writes Qi. The name is kept as that pair. No character was supplied from outside the packet.
高祖 here is the kinship term great-grandfather, not a ruler named Gaozu.
上, the emperor, after Dezong is named in s0212, is treated as Dezong. Strongly inferred.
Zhao in the list of tombs is 昭陵, not Zhao Jing.
Zan's sons and younger brothers are unnamed and are not separate people.
中平 is inside 天寶中平陽 and is not a separate reign or person.
【贊】 is the commentary label, not the person Zan. 君上 is the ruler's admonition and is not given a new personal name.
時主, the ruler of the age, is not identified with Dezong.
竇 and 齊 in the verse are read as Dou Can and Qi Ying, the pair already named in s0260 and s0261. Strongly inferred.
滋 and 邁 in the commentary are Liu Zi and Lu Mai, matching the names in the biographies above. The commentary does not repeat the surnames.
